Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact three-row page navigation list, original region20,380,350,126 normalized. Exact Japanese row labels: はじめての方へ / やることリスト / 打ち合わせメモ. All Meiryo REGULAR40014px/24px,tracking0; ordinary light bodyweight, no bold. Restore ORIGINAL page icons, NOT saved mock substitutions: first ORIGINAL yellow waving-hand emoji artwork with tiny motion marks, preserve hand shape and original yellow shading, not a document; second ORIGINAL checklist icon with THREE small checkmarks and THREE horizontal lines (forest-green#1F6444), not a singlecheck; third source folded-corner document outline with two short internal text lines, slate#526173. Keep source icon geometry/optical sizes and a shared aligned iconcolumn with consistent textbaselines; no icon tile fills. White/pure-white canvas, compact44px logical rows, no enclosing card, no borders/dividers/chevrons or selectionfills. Preserve source hand artwork colors as artwork and green checklist identity, no unrelated accent. Uniformly enlarge350px logical width/126px height to readable wide1400x650 with restrained white margin. No sectionheading, dates, English labels, phone or other source content.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Preserve source yellowhand artwork and meaningfulgreen checklist identity, adapted forestgreen. Thirdpaper ordinaryslate. Do not flatten originalartwork into monochrome or add randomcolors.
